Name: ServerPortChanger
Author: phantomgamerz
Description:
This mod lets you change the port that your server is hosted on.
By default this port is 24642, but by installing this mod you can change it to whatever you want!

[b][u][size=4]INSTALL[/size]
[/u][/b]Simply unzip the ServerPortChanger folder to your SMAPI mods folder and edit the config.json file within it to change the port that your server will be hosted on.

[size=4][b][u]CREDITS
[/u][/b][/size]Thanks a ton to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/42440425]Platonymous[/url] for helping me out, I've never used Harmony before so this has been a major learning experience!
Go over to his mod page and check out his mods to support him if you enjoyed this mod.
Also thanks to Meeeow on the Stardew Valley discord for offering many tips!

[b][u][size=4]COMPATIBILITY
[/size][/u][/b]This should be compatible with any mod that doesn't also happen to change the port that the server is hosted on.
It was built for Stardew Valley 1.3.28 & SMAPI 2.7, it has not yet been tested with SMAPI 2.8.
